entries.label: CAT_0_OPT_0_DESC
entries.body:
Lo-res 320x240 resolution.
Available with SDL framebuffer or OpenGL.
entries.source:
Lo-res 320x240 resolution.
Available with SDL framebuffer or OpenGL.
entries.translation:
低解析度 320x240。
可搭配 SDL 影格緩衝區或 OpenGL 使用。

entries.label: CAT_0_OPT_1_DESC
entries.body:
Hi-res 640x480 resolution.
Requires 'Hires2x' package installed.
entries.source:
Hi-res 640x480 resolution.
Requires 'Hires2x' package installed.
entries.translation:
高解析度 640x480。
必須安裝「Hires2 x」套件。

entries.label: CAT_0_OPT_2_DESC
entries.body:
Hi-res 1280x960 resolution.
Requires 'Hires4x' package installed.
entries.source:
Hi-res 1280x960 resolution.
Requires 'Hires4x' package installed.
entries.translation:
高解析度 1280x960。
必須安裝「Hires4 x」套件。

entries.body:

entries.source:

Never
entries.translation:

entries.label: CAT_1_OPT_0_DESC
entries.body:
Uses SDL Framebuffer mode if possible,
and OpenGL otherwise.  Framebuffer mode
is available for Lo-res 320 and 320->640 modes.
entries.source:
Uses SDL Framebuffer mode if possible,
and OpenGL otherwise.  Framebuffer mode
is available for Lo-res 320 and 320->640 modes.
entries.translation:
可能時使用 SDL 影格緩衝區模式，
否則使用 OpenGL。 影格緩衝區模式
適用於低解析度 320 與 320->640 模式。

entries.label: CAT_1_OPT_1_DESC
entries.body:
Always use OpenGL.
OpenGL can produce any resolution and is
usually hardware-accelerated.
entries.source:
Always use OpenGL.
OpenGL can produce any resolution and is
usually hardware-accelerated.
entries.translation:
一律使用 OpenGL。
OpenGL 可輸出任何解析度，而且
通常會使用硬體加速。

entries.label: CAT_2_OPT_0_DESC
entries.body:
No scaling. Fastest option.
Will look bad in 1280x960 fullscreen mode
if the monitor's resolution is smaller.
entries.source:
No scaling. Fastest option.
Will look bad in 1280x960 fullscreen mode
if the monitor's resolution is smaller.
entries.translation:
不進行縮放。速度最快。
若螢幕解析度較低，以 1280x960 全螢幕模式顯示時
畫面效果會很差。

entries.label: CAT_2_OPT_1_DESC
entries.body:
Bilinear average scaling.
A simple, fast blending technique.
Should be used in fullscreen mode!
entries.source:
Bilinear average scaling.
A simple, fast blending technique.
Should be used in fullscreen mode!
entries.translation:
雙線性平均縮放。
簡單快速的混合技術。
全螢幕模式下應使用此選 項！

entries.label: CAT_2_OPT_2_DESC
entries.body:
Adaptive bilinear scaling.
A slower, less blurry blending technique.
Affects only 320x240 mode.
entries.source:
Adaptive bilinear scaling.
A slower, less blurry blending technique.
Affects only 320x240 mode.
entries.translation:
自適應雙線性縮放。
速度較慢，但模糊程度較低 的混合技術。
僅影響 320x240 模式。

entries.label: CAT_2_OPT_3_DESC
entries.body:
Advanced bilinear scaling.
Hand-weighted blend that produces smoother curves.
Affects only 320x240 mode.
entries.source:
Advanced bilinear scaling.
Hand-weighted blend that produces smoother curves.
Affects only 320x240 mode.
entries.translation:
進階雙線性縮放。
手動加權混合， 可產生更平滑的曲線。
僅影響 320x240 模式。

entries.label: CAT_2_OPT_4_DESC
entries.body:
An interpolating scaler.
Produces sharp edges, but at a higher resolution.
Affects only 320x240 mode.
entries.source:
An interpolating scaler.
Produces sharp edges, but at a higher resolution.
Affects only 320x240 mode.
entries.translation:
插值縮放器。
以較高解析度產生銳利邊 緣。
僅影響 320x240 模式。

entries.label: CAT_2_OPT_5_DESC
entries.body:
A high quality, very expensive interpolating scaler.
Produces sharp edges, but at a higher resolution.
Affects only 320x240 mode.
entries.source:
A high quality, very expensive interpolating scaler.
Produces sharp edges, but at a higher resolution.
Affects only 320x240 mode.
entries.translation:
高品質且運算成本極高的插 值縮放器。
以較高解析度產生銳利邊 緣。
僅影響 320x240 模式。
